ज्या, ii. 9, जिना, नी, Par. i. 4, जीय, Ātm. ved.
 1. To overpower (ved.).
 2. To be overpowered (जीय, ved.).
 3. † To decay, to become old. जीन, see separately.
 --Cf. βία (= ved. ज्या), βιάω, etc., probably also βῑνέω.
ज्याय, a denominat. derived from the last Ātm. To represent a bow-string,

ज्या + यंस्, comparat. of प्रशस्य and वृद्ध, f. ज्यायसी,
 1. More powerful (ved.).
 2. Stronger,
ज्यायिष्ठ, anomal. superl. of प्रशस्य (cf. ज्येष्ठ), Best,
